evidence.title: Why Restaurant Prices Could Rise Again as Food Inflation Returns - Restaurant India
evidence.snippet: ## How Does a Kiosk Connect With a POS? The POS acts as an important bridge between the kiosk and the restaurant's operations. A simplified technology flow looks like this: Kiosk → Integration/API → POS → KDS → Kitchen [...] Ideally, the system should synchronise menu items, prices, modifiers, taxes and availability. Suppose a restaurant sells out of a particular dessert. If the menu system is properly integrated, that item can be marked unavailable across connected ordering channels. This prevents a customer from paying for something that the kitchen cannot provide. Restaurants should ask vendors whether the integration is native, API-based, middleware-based or custom-built. That difference can affect [...] still be where the relationship begins. But increasingly, it is not where the business ends.

evidence.title: Best Recipe Costing Software 2026: 10 Tools Compared (Free & Paid) | AI Chef Pro Blog
evidence.snippet: What sets AI Chef Pro apart is its artificial intelligence integration. The platform doesn’t just calculate costs—it predicts them. Users can input ingredient price changes and immediately see how menu items will be affected. The AI suggests optimal menu pricing based on target food cost percentages, identifies recipes with the highest profit margins, and even analyzes sales data to recommend which dishes to promote. With support for 7 languages, it’s ideal for international restaurant groups [...] With strong purchasing and inventory features alongside recipe costing, MarketMan provides a holistic view of food costs from procurement through plate. The platform’s vendor management tools help operators track supplier performance, compare pricing across vendors, and ensure consistent quality.
